value.rationale: A physically motivated renewal-rate acceleration model has exactly linear MSD for every lag but its fourth standardized moment has a sharp non-Gaussian trichotomy controlled by a/b. The borderline logarithm and exact subcritical amplitude are not routine restatements of Gaussian subordination; they quantify the finite-observation cutoff of a heavy-tailed instantaneous diffusivity. The result is self-contained, naturally parameterized and relevant to anomalous-transport diagnostics; no unproved experimental robustness is asserted.
